# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This knowledge base is synthesized from real sales call recordings of BSC (Bharat Steel Group / Bharat Steel Chennai Pvt. Ltd.), an industrial steel stockist and distributor operating out of Chennai (godown/processing facility at Vichur / Thirunilai Village near Manali/Ponneri, Tamil Nadu).

The call volume reflects a high-velocity B2B steel distribution desk handling structural fabricators, OEM vendors, component manufacturers, and local traders across Tamil Nadu and neighboring regions (Chennai, Trichy, Hosur, Salem, Mettur, Pudukkottai, Pondicherry). Key internal roles appearing in the calls include primary sales rep **Varsha**, sales coordinator/manager **Vijayalakshmi**, management/pricing decision-maker **Gaurav Sir**, operational and godown coordinators **Satya**, **Kumar**, and **Pramith**, and yard dispatch/weighment operator **Jagan**.

Genuine sales calls center on:
1. Sizing and inventory availability checks (plates, cut-to-length sheets, heavy sections, channels).
2. Tonnage pricing, coil-to-coil vs. cut-piece pricing structures.
3. Strict enforcement of payment terms (100% advance before gate release).
4. Physical dispatch coordination, customer inspections (UT/visual), and Test Certificate (MTC/TC) matching.

---

## Products & brand ladder

BSC operates primarily as a primary steel distributor and coil processor. BSC **does not** stock roofing sheets directly (inquiries for roofing/decking sheets are routed to sister concern *Crayon Roofing and Structures*), nor does it stock thin sheet below 2 mm, hollow square/round ERW pipes, or round bars.

### 1. Hot Rolled (HR) Plates & Sheets
* **Thickness Range:** 2.0 mm to 32 mm+ (commonly 3 mm, 4 mm, 5 mm, 6 mm, 8 mm, 10 mm, 12 mm, 16 mm, 20 mm, 25 mm, 30 mm, 32 mm). Thin sheets (< 2 mm) are strictly unavailable: *“1.5 எல்லாம் இல்ல sir 2 mm மேலதான்”* [1.5 mm is not available sir, only above 2 mm].
* **Grades:** IS 2062 E250 BR and E350 BR. BSC **does not** deal in E350C/CR, S355JR, or boiler quality (SA 516 Gr 70): *“C grade நம்மகிட்ட கிடையாது. E350 BR-க்கு நான் அனுப்புறேன்”* [We do not have C grade. I will quote for E350 BR].
* **Standard Plate Dimensions:** 
  * Widths: 1,250 mm, 1,500 mm, 2,000 mm, 2,500 mm.
  * Lengths: 2,500 mm, 6,300 mm, 12,000 mm / 12,500 mm.
* **Processing:** In-house Cut-To-Length (CTL) and gas cutting lines for standard plate splitting (e.g., center cuts of 12.5 m to 6.3 m or 5 m).

### 2. Chequered / Checkered Plates
* **Thicknesses:** 4 mm, 5 mm, 6 mm (3 mm checkered is obsolete/unavailable in primary mills).
* **Standard Sizes:** 1,250 × 2,500 mm (8 × 4 ft equivalents).
* **Makes:** Predominantly JSW, SAIL.

### 3. Structural Steel (Heavy & Medium Sections)
* **Channels (ISMC):** 75×40 (prolonged market rolling shortage across mills), 100×50, 125×65, 150×75, 200, 250 mm.
* **Beams & Columns:**
  * Narrow Parallel Beams (NPB): 200, 300, 350, 400, 450 mm.
  * Wide Flange Beams / Columns: WBP 300 × 300 (117 kg/m).
  * Standard Beams (ISMB): 150, 200, 250, 400, 450 mm.
* **Angles (Equal Angles):** 50×50×6, 65×65×6, 75×75, 90×90×8, 110×12 mm. Note: 40×6 and smaller sizes come in commercial/rolling makes; primary mills (SAIL/Vizag) start above 50 mm.

### 4. TMT Rebars
* **Sizes:** 10 mm, 12 mm (sold in bent bundles / U-bend or straight 12 m lengths).

### Brand / Mill Hierarchy Explained to Buyers
1. **Primary Mills (A-Tier):** SAIL, Vizag (RINL / VSP), NMDC.
   * *Staff Line on NMDC:* *“NMDC-னா என்ன அது sale கிடையாது இல்ல... sale-க்கு merge ஆனதுதான் NMDC இருந்தாங்க இப்போ அவங்க தனியா வந்துட்டாங்க... government brand தான்”* [NMDC was formerly associated with SAIL, now demerged; it is an equivalent government primary brand].
2. **Secondary / Re-rolling Mills:** Used strictly for small angles (40×6 mm) or commercial square bars (50×50 mm) where primary mills do not roll.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

### 1. Product Rates Captured in Transcripts
* **HR Plates (Standard Sizes, E250 / Commercial):**
  * Full Coil-to-Coil (20T lot): **₹57,500 / MT** (base).
  * 3 mm Plate (1,250 × 2,500 mm / 3T–5T): **₹58,000 – ₹58,500 / MT**.
  * 5 mm Base Plate (cut 4×8 ft, approx. 130 kg/sheet): **₹60 / kg** (₹60,000 / MT).
  * 6 mm / 8 mm / 10 mm / 12 mm Plates: **₹58,500 – ₹61,500 / MT**.
  * 16 mm / 20 mm Plates: **₹60,000 – ₹63,000 / MT**.
  * 25 mm Plate (small 1T order): **₹62,500 – ₹63,000 / MT**.
  * 32 mm Cut Plates (E350 High Tensile): Sourced/negotiated at **₹64,300 – ₹68,000 / MT**; settled after negotiation between **₹66,000 and ₹67,000 / MT**.
  * Small Cut-to-Size Plates (12 mm / 16 mm retail lots, 3–5 tons): **₹70 – ₹72 / kg** + GST.
* **Chequered Plates:**
  * 4 mm / 6 mm (JSW / SAIL): **₹62,000 – ₹62,500 / MT**.
* **Structurals (Angles, Beams, Channels):**
  * 125 Channel (Vizag make): **₹61,000 / MT**; SAIL make: **₹59,500 / MT**.
  * 50×50×6 Angle (Vizag/SAIL): **₹63,000 – ₹63,600 / MT**.
  * 200 Channel (12 m): **₹63,000 / MT**.
  * 250 Beam (ISMB / NPB): **₹64,500 / MT**.
  * 50×50 Square Bar (Commercial rolling): **₹53,000 / MT**.
* **TMT Bars:**
  * 10 mm / 12 mm (SAIL / Vizag): **₹54,500 – ₹55,510 / MT** basic.

### 2. Mandatory Commercial Add-ons & Surcharges
* **Loading Charges:** Standard warehouse loading fee of **₹300 – ₹325 / MT**.
* **Billing / Payment Admin Charges:** Fixed billing ledger entry fee of **₹200 – ₹300 per bill**.
* **Cutting Charges:** Standard center-cutting or plate splitting: **₹500 – ₹1,000 / MT** (e.g., *“cutting-கே நான் உங்களுக்கு கம்மியா கொடுத்திருக்கேன்... ₹500 பத்தன்னு தான்”* [I have charged very little for cutting, only ₹500 per ton]).
